allowed_geometry_facts: existing explicit dimensional or interface facts
holdout_policy: apply unchanged and persist only allowed metadata plus sealed hashes
input: frozen manifest metadata plus persisted derived-reference.json

qualification_gate.ambiguity: fail closed; replacement or enrichment remains required
qualification_gate.critical_interface_geometry: at least one explicit dimensional constraint beyond output count
qualification_gate.major_envelope: coarse envelope for every canonical output
qualification_gate.multi_part_relationships: explicit output mapping or relationship facts for multi-part designs
qualification_gate.output_identity: explicit canonical part membership and count
qualification_gate.principal_mating_geometry: at least one explicit dimensional/interface fact
qualification_gate.selected_variant: explicit canonical filename and selection reason

similarity_rule: only comparison_ready projects receive interpreted reference-similarity metrics
validation_policy: apply unchanged; do not tune per project after development results
